articles.title: Coast Guard finds vessel-like object on seabed amid search for missing fishing boat
articles.description: The Coast Guard said Sunday it has located an object believed to be a sunken vessel on the seabed near where a fishing boat went missing off South Korea's west coast last week. The unidentified object was detected by naval sonar at 7:55 p.m. Saturday, according to the Taean Coast Guard. The object lies 52 meters deep and roughly 41 kilometers northwest of an island off Taean, about 110 km southwest of Seoul. The location is near the site where the fishing boat Haegwangho went missing Wednesday.
